request.message:
Add visible-event disclosure controls for saved fixture review

Add Expand shown events and Collapse shown events to the saved-record filter. Preserve hidden disclosure state, existing row identity, filter values and complete record exports.

Eight focused groups passed in one captured local run. Actual browser receiving remains separate. Isolated source offer for issue #82; default, Pages and Actions remain unchanged.

cause: The commit connector returns only structuredContent.sha; the wrapper wrongly expected tree.sha. No branch creation was attempted. The first response was not saved before the assertion, so its SHA is unavailable here.
successor: Repeat the same commit object request once, retain its response first, and fetch full commit metadata before branch creation.
